up: Retrieve molecules reported in document CHEMBL5360622. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5360622'
